credentialRequirements.description: MongoDB connection string supplied only within the credential adapter and scoped to the intended deployment and least-privileged database user. The reusable connection string must never be returned to the proposer.

aggregate.description: Run an aggregation against a MongoDB collection

aggregate-db.description: Run an aggregation against a MongoDB database

atlas-local-connect-deployment.description: Connect to a MongoDB Atlas Local deployment

atlas-local-create-deployment.description: Create a MongoDB Atlas local deployment. Default image is preview. When the user does not specify an image tag, inform them that preview is used by default and provide this link for more information: https://hub.docker.com/r/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-local

atlas-local-delete-deployment.description: Delete a MongoDB Atlas local deployment

collection-indexes.description: Describe the indexes for a collection

collection-schema.description: Describe the schema for a collection

collection-storage-size.description: Gets the size of the collection

connect.description: Connect to a MongoDB instance. The config resource captures if the server is already connected to a MongoDB cluster. If the user has configured a connection string or has previously called the connect tool, a connection is already established and there's no need to call this tool unless the user has explicitly requested to switch to a new MongoDB cluster.

count.description: Gets the number of documents in a MongoDB collection using db.collection.count() and query as an optional filter parameter

create-collection.description: Creates a new collection in a database. If the database doesn't exist, it will be created automatically.

create-index.description: Create an index for a collection

db-stats.description: Returns statistics that reflect the use state of a single database

delete-many.description: Removes all documents that match the filter from a MongoDB collection

drop-collection.description: Removes a collection or view from the database. The method also removes any indexes associated with the dropped collection.

drop-database.description: Removes the specified database, deleting the associated data files

drop-index.description: Drop an index for the provided database and collection.

explain.description: Returns statistics describing the execution of the winning plan chosen by the query optimizer for the evaluated method

export.description: Export a query or aggregation results in the specified EJSON format.

find.description: Run a find query against a MongoDB collection

insert-many.description: Insert an array of documents into a MongoDB collection. If the list of documents is above com.mongodb/maxRequestPayloadBytes, consider inserting them in batches.

list-collections.description: List all collections for a given database

list-databases.description: List all databases for a MongoDB connection

list-knowledge-sources.description: List available data sources in the MongoDB Assistant knowledge base. Use this to explore available data sources or to find search filter parameters to use in search-knowledge.

mongodb-logs.description: Returns the most recent logged mongod events

rename-collection.description: Renames a collection in a MongoDB database

search-knowledge.description: Search for information in the MongoDB Assistant knowledge base. This includes official documentation, curated expert guidance, and other resources provided by MongoDB. Supports filtering by data source and version.

update-many.description: Updates all documents that match the specified filter for a collection. If the list of documents is above com.mongodb/maxRequestPayloadBytes, consider updating them in batches.
